name: Can functional layout improvements increase my property value?

mainEntity.name: Can functional layout improvements increase my property value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, well-executed functional layout improvements can significantly increase your property value by making your home more appealing and practical to potential buyers. Modern, efficient, and well-designed spaces are highly sought after. Enhancements like open-concept living, improved kitchen flow, or additional usable square footage often yield a good return on investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, quality functional layout improvements can increase property value by enhancing appeal and practicality.
